transcript:
Teacher: 'B' se 5 animals batao English mein. Jo bata dega use ye chocolate milegi. [Tell 5 animals starting with 'B' in English. Whoever tells will get this chocolate.]
Boy: Bear, Bull, Bat, Baboon, Butterfly.
Teacher: 5 second mein 5 jawab? Achha, chalo rapid fire. Billi? [5 answers in 5 seconds? Okay, let's do rapid fire. Cat?]
Boy: Cat.
Teacher: Kutta? [Dog?]
Boy: Dog.
Teacher: Bandar? [Monkey?]
Boy: Monkey.
Teacher: Lomdi? [Fox?]
Boy: Fox.
Teacher: Genda? [Rhino?]
Boy: Rhinoceros.
Teacher: Cheel? [Eagle?]
Boy: Eagle.
Teacher: Saanp? [Snake?]
Boy: Snake.
Teacher: Chuha? [Mouse?]
Boy: Mouse. Aur agar bahut saare hon to mice. [And if there are many, then mice.]
Teacher: Ullu? [Owl?]
Boy: Owl.
Teacher: Achha, Dolphin ko Hindi mein kya bolte hain? [Okay, what do we call Dolphin in Hindi?]
Boy: Mam, Dolphin ko Hindi mein bhi Dolphin hi bolte hain. [Ma'am, Dolphin is called Dolphin in Hindi too.]
Teacher: 12 samajh, 12 ke 12 sahi. Mouse ka plural bhi bata diya. Beta, ye kaun sikhata hai? Tuition? [12 understandings, all 12 correct. Even told the plural of mouse. Son, who teaches you this? Tuition?]
Boy: Nahi mam, English Seekho app se sikha. [No ma'am, learned from English Seekho app.]
Teacher: App se animals ke naam aa gaye? [You learned animal names from an app?]
Boy: Mam, English Seekho app pe vocabulary ka section hai. Animals ka ek show hai. Har jaanwar ki videos dikhate hain. Jungle mein kaise rehta hai, kya khata hai, English mein kya bolte hain. Sab 2 se 3 minute mein. Ratta nahi, dekh ke sikha. [Ma'am, there is a vocabulary section on the English Seekho app. There is an animal show. They show videos of every animal. How it lives in the jungle, what it eats, what it's called in English. All in 2 to 3 minutes. Not by rote learning, but by watching.]
Teacher: Par chameleon ki spelling bhi yaad hai? Ye kaise? [But you also remember the spelling of chameleon? How?]
Boy: Mam, kyunki app mein spelling challenge hota hai. Word dikhta hai, phir gayab ho jata hai, phir likhna hota hai. Game jaisa hai. Kitaab mein ek baar padho, bhool jao. App mein khel-khel mein yaad ho jata hai. [Ma'am, because there is a spelling challenge in the app. The word appears, then disappears, then you have to write it. It's like a game. Read once in a book, you forget. In the app, you learn while playing.]
Teacher: Aur sirf animals hi hain usmein? [And are there only animals in it?]
Boy: Nahi mam, spoken English bhi hai, daily life English bhi, grammar bhi. Aur AI coach hai 24 ghante available. Usse chat karke practice karo. Galat likho, sudhaar degi. 100 baar sudhaar degi. ₹1 mein trial. [No ma'am, there is spoken English too, daily life English, grammar too. And there is an AI coach available 24 hours. Chat with it to practice. If you write wrong, it will correct you. It will correct you 100 times. Trial for ₹1.]
Teacher: Chalo achha bachon, hathi ko English mein kya bolte hain? [Okay children, what do we call elephant in English?]
Boy: Elephant. E-L-E-P-H-A-N-T.
Teacher: Dekha? Poori class chup, ye akela bol raha hai. English Seekho app download kariye, ₹1 mein trial. Apne bache ki English aisi banaiye. [See? The whole class is silent, only he is speaking. Download the English Seekho app, trial for ₹1. Make your child's English like this.]
Boy: Mam, ek aur bataun? Ullu ko English mein Owl bolte hain, lekin Hindi mein ullu ka matlab bewakoof bhi hota hai. To technically, jo English nahi sikhta, wo ullu hai. [Ma'am, shall I tell you one more? Owl is called Owl in English, but in Hindi, 'ullu' also means a fool. So technically, whoever doesn't learn English is an owl.]
Teacher: Ye bacha mujhe bhi sikha ke jayega. [This kid will end up teaching me too.]
Voiceover: To install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A classroom skit features a young boy who easily answers all of his teacher's English vocabulary questions. He credits his quick learning to the English Seekho app's interactive features, such as spelling challenges and an AI coach. The teacher then urges parents to download the app for a ₹1 trial.
